payload.text: **THE CLI ROUTING RULE IS `EXISTS AND ANSWERS`, NEVER `PRESENT`, AND THE STALE SOCKET IS THE CASE THAT SEPARATES THEM.** `design.md:22` rules it: *if the intentd socket exists and answers, the CLI MUST route to it*; when it does not, the CLI executes in-process against the same facade, and **two sync engines never run concurrently**. **A dead daemon leaves its socket file behind**, so a presence test routes every verb at an endpoint nobody is listening on -- asserted by driving a stale endpoint explicitly, never by driving only the live and absent cases. **The rule is keyed on the ENDPOINT and not on a transport**: D56 gives the daemon one output contract, GraphQL/JSON over the socket AND over HTTP (`design.md:487`), so routing folds over a LIST of candidates whose body names no transport and a third one is a new variant rather than an edit. **The earlier wording of this row said `socket present` and that is the defect this row now names** -- a précis that rots while the citation it summarises stays right (cc, 2026-08-29, found while building the seam).
